verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Ezra 6

Achmetha = Ecbatana; Diodorus 2.32.4 on Persian royal parchments (Yamauchi); de Vaux: Persian kings wintered in Babylon and summered at Susa or Ecbatana, and Cyrus left Babylon in spring 538 — a forger would not have known to place the scroll there; 60-cubit dimensions read as limits (Guzik); Kenyon's straight joint as possible remains of Zerubbabel's building (via Yamauchi); Herodotus 3.159 and Behistun on Darius's impalements (Yamauchi); the 1973 Xanthos trilingual cult charter as a parallel for Persian support of local cults (Yamauchi); four years from resumption to completion; Artaxerxes in 6:14 added "to complete the picture" (Kidner)
